source_type.description: What the image shows: the physical part, its bag or label, a shop or product page screenshot, a mix, or something else.

items.description: One entry per distinct part type. Identical parts count as one item with a quantity estimate.

name.description: Short, human-friendly name as it should appear in the inventory, e.g. "TP4056 Li-ion charger module (USB-C)".

category_path.description: Category from general to specific, e.g. ["Modules", "Power", "Battery chargers"].

mpn.description: Manufacturer part number, only if read from the image or certain. Never guessed.

manufacturer.description: Chip or part manufacturer if known; null for generic or unbranded parts.

package.description: Package or footprint, e.g. "SOP-8", "0805", "TO-220", "DIP-16"; null for modules.

key_parameters.description: The few parameters that distinguish this part, e.g. resistance, voltage, interface.

visible_markings.description: Text and codes read verbatim from the part, silkscreen or label.

quantity_estimate.description: How many pieces are visible or stated on the packaging; null if unclear.

search_terms.description: 2-5 terms to look this part up in the inventory, most specific first.

notes.description: Anything a human should check, e.g. a likely clone, a variant ambiguity, or a missing marking.

needs_better_photo.description: True if a different photo would clearly improve the identification.

photo_advice.description: If needs_better_photo is true: one short, concrete tip, e.g. "Photograph the chip markings up close".
